༄༅/ /dpal sngags kyi bdag mo'i sgrub thabs snying gi dum bu bzhugs/ /

tei:div.tei:p: ༄༅/ /dpal sngags kyi bdag mo'i sgrub thabs

snying gi dum bu bzhugs/ / dpal ldan dang po'i sangs rgyas la/ /btud de bstan pa bsrung ba'i phyir/ /rgyud lung man ngag nyams myong bzhin/ /sngags kyi bdag mo'i sgrub thabs bri/ 'di la gsum ste/ bsnyen pa dang*/ sgrub pa dang*/ las sbyor ro/ /dang po ni rnal 'byor pa dam tshig dang ldan pas dbyings kyi kun tu bzang po yab yum du bsgom ste/ mdun du sngags bdag bskyed la rtsa sngags brgya rtsa re dang*/ gtor mas mnyes par byas la/ bstod bskul gyis las bcol zhing*/ gong bzlas su 'bum phrag gcig bya'o/ /des ni sgrub thag nye zhing bar chad mi 'byung ngo*/ / gnyis pa sgrub pa la gsum ste/ bca' gzhi'i rdzas bsags pa dang*/ sgom bzlas bya ba/ gtor ma gtang ba'o/ /dang po ni dur khrod la sogs par maṇ+ḍal mda' gang gru gsum pa'i dbus su ma mo'i bris sku btsugs pa'i mdun du dmar gtor chen po gcig bshams pa'i mthar mchod pas bskor zhing*/ thun rdzas lcags phye/ zangs phye/ rdo phye/ nyung dkar/ khrag sna dang bcas pa thun dong du gzhag cing*/ dgra'i ling ga yang kha sbub tu gzhag go /gnyis pa sgom bzlas bya ba ni/ kha nub byang du bltas la gos nag po gon nas 'dug ste/ skyabs 'gro sems bskyed/ stong nyid du bsgom pa'i ngang las me dpung 'bar ba'i dbus su rang nyid pad nyi'i steng du e las dbyings kyi kun tu bzang mo mthing nag mche ba gtsigs shing brkyang bskum du bzhugs pa'i phyag na dam tshig gi gun+dhe 'phred la 'dzin zhing*/ mi lpags kyi g.yang gzhi gsol bar bsams la ā+oṃ ru lu ru lu hūṃ bh+yo hūṃ/ zhes brgya rtsa brgyad bzlas nas/ mdun du khrag mtsho khol ma'i dkyil du keng rus kyi ri rab spungs pa/ de'i steng pad+ma nyi ma'i dbus su trag las sngags bdag smug nag zhal gcig nas mche ba gtsigs shing ral pa gcig dang*/ spyan gcig las mchi ma khrag tu 'bab pa/ phyag g.yas tsit+ta zhal du gsol zhing*/

g.yon zhing chung gi rgyal mtshan 'phyar ba/ dbu la thod pa'i phreng ba bcings shing ral pa dmar ser gyen du 'khyil ba/ zhabs g.yas bskum g.yon brkyang gcer bu'i tshul du bsams la/ oṃ ro ru e ka tsa ti snying khar ga ru lu ru lu hūṃ bh+yo hūṃ/ dzadzaḥ zhes nub byang nas bsgoms pa lta bu'i sngags bdag ma mo bdun 'bum gyi 'khor dang bcas pa skad cig gis byon nas bris sku la thim par bsams la/ cung zad yid kyis mchod nas/ ā+oṃ ma ma trag rak+ṣa snying thum rbad myogs thum rbad snying gzer srog 'dar yed chuṃ ya srog srig srig shaṃ khyer bh+yoḥ zhes pa rbad sngags bzlas nas/ dus gnad dang bstun la thun gyis ling ga brab cing bsad sngags bzla'au/ /de nas gtor ma raṃ yaṃ khaṃ gis bsangs sbyangs byas te/ ā+oṃ aḥhūm̐ gis sha khrag gi ri dang rgya mtshor bsams la/ 'bod sngags kyi mjug tu/ ma ma rag mo e ka tsa ti i daṃ ba ling ta kha kha khā hi khā hi/ zhes bdun gyis phul la/ hūṃ bskal pa me ltar 'bar ba'i dur khrod nas/ /shin tu gsod pa'i smug nag khro mo ni/ /nam mkha'i gzugs can lho sprin go zu can/ /tsit+ta za zhing dam nyams snying khrag 'dren/ / zhing chung dbyugs pas dgra snying tshal par 'gems/ /'jigs byed chen mo ral pa'i thor gtsugs can/ /dpral na mig gcig srid gsum khungs nas 'byin/ /zhal na tshems gcig dgra bo'i srog gcod ma/ /tsit+ta 'di gsol dam nyams srog la rngams/ /sha khrag longs spyod dmar gtor 'di bzhes la/ /dam tshig dbang gis dam nyams gshed ma mdzod/ /ma mo srog la 'gyed phyir 'di gsol la/ /bdag gis bcol pa'i phrin las 'grub par mdzod/ /dam tshig dus la bab po sa ma yaḥ /zhes bstod bskul bya'o/ / de'ang zhag nyer gcig sgrub ste/ zhag bdun du 'bod sngags gtso bor bzlas shing*/ gzhan gnyis zhag la bzla ba'o/ /de nas zhag bdun gyi bar du rbad sngags gtso bor bzlas zhing*/

snga phyi gnyis zhar la bzlas so/ /de nas zhag bdun du bsad sngags gtso bor bzlas shing brab pa ste/ 'bod rbad sngon du song tsam bya'o/ /de'i yi bar du rmi lam cho 'phrul bsam gyis mi khyab pa 'byung bas/ mi 'jigs lta ba'i gdeng gis zin pa gces so/ /don gsum pa las la sbyar ba ni/ de ltar bsnyen sgrub thengs cig thems nas/ kha gso ba tsam las bskyar nas sgrub mi dgos pas/ las mtha' gang la'ang dus gnad kyis 'grub ste/ drag sngags gshor la gtad pa yin pa'i phyir ro/ /de yang bsnyen pa la 'bum/ sgrub pa la 'bum phrag gnyis te/ sum 'bum song nas zla ba bzhi yi dus gnad la bsad sngags kyis brab cing skyes pa grir shi ba'i snying ngam/ rabs chad kyi snying nang du ling ga bcug nas/ nas nag gi zan dron gyis gril te dgra phyogs su 'phangs pas/ khrag nad dang*/ rgyu gzer dang*/ rims nad dang*/ gzer nad dang*/ smyo nad la sogs pa drag pos thebs nas khrag tu skyugs te zhag bdun las mi 'gor bar las 'grub bo/ /skabs su ra lpags gyon la ra gsob dgra phyogs su rdul zhing*/ rbad sngags dang dmod bcol dang gtor zor 'phangs pas kyang*/ dgra'i yul der nad yams dang 'tshe ba rgyun mi 'chad pa 'byung ngo*/ /de la ma mo rgyu ba'i dus nges pa ni/ lo gcig la zhag nyi shu rtsa bzhi las/ gsad pa'i dus bzhi ni dgun zla ra ba'i tshes bco lnga'i srod la shar nas nub tu rgyu bas/ ling ga shing bu la btags te kha shar du blta ba la bong nga'i dud pas bdug cing*/ rang nyid gshin rje dmar nag tu bsgom la kha nub tu blta bas/ nyung nag dang dug khrag gis brab cing*/ ā+oṃ ma ma srog gtubs gtubs lam sod rag mo snying khrag sa ma ya bh+yo/ zhes brgya rtsa brgyad bzlas so/ /dpyid zla ra ba'i tshes bzhi'i nam phyed na nub nas shar du rgyu bas/ ling ga shar nas nub tu kha bstan la/ rang nyid shar du blta ba'i gdong la ro sol gyis byugs te/

skra spyi bor bcings nas/ khrag sna dang dug sna'i thun gyis brab cing*/ tsa tsa shi shi snying khrag 'dir shag lu 'u tsa tsa ya ya ma hā snying dar snying thum shag ma ma e ka tsa ti srog thun rbad/ ces stong phrag gcig bzlas nas/ snga ma bzhin 'phangs so/ /dbyar zla ra ba'i tshes bcu bdun gyi sa rub mtshams su lho nas byang du rgyu bas/ ling ga lhor bstan la/ rang nyid byang du blta bas gcer bur 'dug ste/ thal chen gyis brab cing*/ rag mo rag mo snying sha ku ru dza dza snying shag khos/ zhes pa brgya rtsa bzlas so/ /ston zla ra ba'i tshes drug gi nam mkha' mtha' bteg byung dus byang nas lhor rgyu bas ling ga byang du kha bstan la/ rang nyid lhor bltas te bya mo nag mo'i sgong zor deng deng byed cing*/ ma ma e ka tsa ti snying thuṃ dzaḥ zhes pa stong gis brab bo/ /des ni las gang yin zhag de nyid la 'grub bo/ dus lhag ma nyi shu ni/ dgun zla ra ba'i stong*/ 'bring po'i tshes brgyad dang nyi shu gnyis tha chung gi tshes bcu dang nyi shu lnga/ dpyid zla ra ba'i tshes dgu /'bring po'i tshes bcu dang nyi shu dgu /tha ma'i tshes gsum dang nyi shu brgyad/ dbyar zla ra ba'i nyi shu bdun/ 'bring po'i tshes bcu dang nyi shu gcig /tha ma'i tshes bcu drug dang nyi shu bdun/ ston zla ra ba'i nyi shu gsum/ 'bring po'i tshes bcu dgu dang nyi shu gcig /tha ma'i tshes gnyis dang nyi shu brgyad la rgyu ba ste/ ston zla gsum gyi tshes rnams las/ tshes drug gi nam bteg pa/ bcu dgu'i nyi ma rtse shar/ tshes gnyis kyi nyi ma phyed nas ma nub kyi bar rnams nyin mor rgyu la/ lhag ma mtshan mor rgyu ba'o/ /de yang nyin zhag gcig la rlung drug cu rtsa bzhir phye bas/ nyin mtshan snyoms dus sum cu rtsa gnyis gnyis rgyu bas 'phel 'grib kyang shes par bya'o/ /de dag gi nges pa ni/ ma mo'i dus gnad nges pa las/ /nges par lo gcig zla ba yang*/ /bcu gnyis rim par ma nor bas/

/nges pa gtan la phab byas te/ / dgun dbyar ston dpyid zla ba la/ /gsum gsum kho na nges rtsis pas/ / dgun zla dang po'i gsum nya dang stong*/ yin nam dpyad/ dang stong*/ /'bring po'i brgyad dang nyi shu gnyis/ /tha ma'i tshes bcu nyi shu lnga/ /dpyid kyi dang po'i bzhi dang dgu/ /'bring po'i bcu dang nyi shu dgu/ /tha ma'i tshes gsum nyi shu brgyad/ /dbyar gyi dang po'i bcu bdun dang*/ /nyi shu dag kyang de bzhin bdun/ /'bring po'i bcu dang nyi shu gcig /tha ma'i bcu drug nyer bdun yin/ /ston gyi dang po'i tshes drug dang*/ /nyi shu gsum la nges par rgyu/ / 'bring po'i bcu dgu nyi shu gcig /tha ma'i gnyis dang nyi shu brgyad/ /de ltar zla ba bcu gnyis la/ /rgyu ba'i zhag ni nyi shu bzhi/ /lhag ma las dag rdugs par 'gyur/ /de la nges pa'i gnad phye na/ /nyin mo rgyu ba gsum las med/ / lhag ma mtshan mo rgyu ba yin/ /dgun zla'i dang po srod dang 'jing*/ /gnyis pa nyi nub brde'u nag /gsum pa phye gung phyed tshad do/ /dpyid zla dang po'i phyed yol dang*/ /de yi cha las rlung ni yang*/ /sum cu rtsa gnyis dag la'o/ / 'bring po'i de ni drug cu bzhi/ /tha chung de ni rlung nyer gnyis/ /dbyar gyi dang po rlung bcu yin/ /phyed dang bdun dang nyi shu ste/ /'bring po'i bzhi'o tha chung drug /ston gyi dang po rlung bzhi cha/ /de yi 'og ma nyi shar dus/ /tha chung nyin phyed mtshan mo'i bar/ /de ni dus nges brtag pa'o/ /zhes so/ /de yang rlung nyi shu po de rnams la gtor ma sbyin pa yin pas rgyu phyogs zhib tu ma smros so/ / gal te las 'gyangs na gshed la dbab pa ni/ dgra bo'i gzugs bag zan dang rkang rjes kyi sa bsres pa la byas pa'i snying kar ro shog la 'khor lo rtsibs bzhi pa'i lte bar dgra'i ming rus/ rtsibs bzhi la bsad sngags tshan bzhi bris pa bcug nas/ tsher ma sna tshogs btsugs la ma mo rgyu ba'i dus bzhir snga ma bzhin bstan la/

de'i mdun du/ e ka tsa ti'i bris sku rgyu phyogs nas ling ga de la zhal bstan pa gnyis kyi bar der yugs sa mo'i dor rta la sogs pa'i mi gtsang ba'i rdzas dud kyis bdug cing*/ bdag nyid rgyu phyogs nas 'khar ba'i phye ma'i thun gyis sku gzugs de'i rgyab nas brab cing*/ 'bod rbad bsad gsum sbrel la bzlas pas/ ma mo khros te dgra de skad cig la snying phyung bar bsam mo/ /des ni mi 'gor bar 'grub nges pa'i gnad do/ /de nas dri bzang dang 'o ma'i chus sku gzugs de me long du shar ba bkrus te/ mchod bstod dang bzod gsol gyis ma mo dbugs dbyung bar bya'o/ /'di snga mas ma grub na bya'i/ gang rung rung du mi bya'o/ /'di lta bu'i gnad yod na/ sngags bdag ma bas kyang byams shing 'dod pa'i don thams cad 'grub pa'o/ /dge ba 'di yis 'gro ba kun/ /bgegs bral dgra rnams med pa dang*/ /sngags bdag dam can rgya mtsho yis/ /dus rnams kun tu bskyang bar shog /dpal sngags kyi bdag mo'i sgrub thabs snying gi dum bu zhes bya ba/ theg pa mchog gi rnal 'byor pa klong chen rab 'byams kyis rgyud dang man ngag dang bla ma dam pa'i zhal gdams rnams gcig tu bsdoms te gsal bar bkod pa rdzogs so/ /dge'o/ /dge'o/ /dge'o// // mes po'i shul bzhag las/ klong chen rab 'byams kyi gsung 'bum/ (10)dpal sngags kyi bdag mo'i sgrub thabs snying gi dum bu/ - PAGE 244 -- PAGE 245 -- PAGE 242 -
